situation: A configured repo is re-run. An option id recorded inside the markers is absent from the forge — the Status field was recreated, or an option was deleted. Hand-written prose outside the markers also names the old id.
expected_guard: the vanished id is refreshed INSIDE the markers and only REPORTED outside them; the change report names the specific constant that moved
must_not: edit the hand-written line outside the markers that names the old id
report only a count of changes — an option id is not interchangeable with a docs root
report `UNCHANGED` because the region still parses
conclude the option was deleted when the probe may have been pointed at the wrong board
